CONNECT with your FUTURE. Through professional, social, and community-focused events, we connect Southampton students with peers, alumni, and employers, helping to level the playing field and champion social mobility on campus and beyond. Become a part of a community made by us for us.

We strive to foster an inclusive environment that encourages meaningful discussion, mutual respect, personal growth, and a deeper understanding of Islam and the legacy of the AhlulBayt. societies.name: Cameroon Catalyst
societies.description: Founded at the University of Southampton, Cameroon Catalyst is a student driven charity which implements infrastructure projects in rural Cameroon which encourage sustainable development. Students fund raise, design and help build the projects in rural Cameroon and over the past ten years the projects completed include a health centre, a school, solar electrification hub, and more recently a series of wells that provide clean water to villages in the region. While the team are supported through a team of qualified trustees, Cameroon Catalyst provides a fantastic opportunity for students wanting a taste of international development charity work. Whether organising fundraising events, designing and building the project or helping promote the work of the charity through media, there is a role for everyone to get great experience. Our current focus is on water and sanitation, as 50% of rural Cameroonians lack access to safe drinking water. We are therefore currently planning a number of news wells to be installed in remote villages to help relieve this issue and provide thousands of people with this basic human right.

societies.name: Capoeira
societies.description: Capoeira was born out of the slave trade around 500 years ago in Brazil. It was developed by the slaves as a martial art, however, it was designed to look like tribal dances and rituals so that the slave masters would not suspect the violent aspect of the art. A crucial component of learning Capoeira has been the ability to mask your movements and intentions in an apparently non-threatening dance, combining combat and music. At Southampton, we have an enthusiastic Capoeira teacher, Mestre Joaozinho, who teaches the Angola style of Capoeira and we also have open training sessions to practice together. You're welcome to come to any of our sessions! Your first session is free. Please see our Instagram page for more info @capoeira.marazul or if you have any more questions feel free to email us.

We also enjoy entering external tournaments including the Hampshire Chess Congress and British Universities Chess Championship. So, come along to our Thursday casual chess nights, Monday competitive nights and our planned socials. Our club nights take place on Thursday evenings in Below Deck on the bottom floor of the SUSU building and the venues and timings of our comp nights and socials are announced on our social media . Previous socials include pub crawls, bowling, quizzes, friendly games with other universities and much more! The committee members are always happy to help or answer any queries or uncertainties prior to or at our meet-ups. Feel free to join our social media here: Discord (https://www.discord.gg/hNEyPdSegv) Instagram (@sotonunichess)

societies.name: Enactus Southampton
societies.description: Enactus Southampton is a student-lead social enterprise and an affiliated society of the University of Southampton Student's Union. 💛Who are we? We turn ideas into reality, creating local impact and changing lives. Enactus Southampton is for everyone. No matter your interests or your degree, there is a role for you here. Not only were we the Official Enactus Team of the Year (woo!) but we also placed 2nd at our national annual competition 2026! 🌟Our Projects/Teams🌟 🍲WonkyBowl: Our FLAGSHIP project! We sell fruity cookies to fund our meal donations to those in need, saving WONKY food from landfill, and providing nutritious meals in Southampton and Winchester. We’ve won competitions including the Sodexo Stop Hunger, and Ford C3 Philanthropy, raising over £4,000 for us this year alone! This year we we’re also featured on BBC News and the Radio. This year we are also planning to expand our healthy eating education programme and get our products out in stores. 🥤SafeSip: This is our newest project! Created in the innovation workshops last year (another excited section of the society!), winning multiple funding competitions, and presenting at Ideas4Impact at the National Expo. Drink spiking is unfortunately growing in the UK, and SafeSip aims to raise awareness and design a drink stirrer that can detect dangerous substances in your drink. Helping people feel less anxious on nights out and genuinely improve nightlife safety. 💡Innovation: Got an idea for a start-up? Passionate for your local community and making change? The Innovation Team is the one for you. You’ll take part in weekly workshops throughout term 1, creating and planning a project idea that tackles the Sustainable Development Goals, presenting at our Innovation Showcase in front of a panel of judges at the end. If you win, you’re project has the chance to become next next Enactus Southampton project, just like SafeSip! 🪩Marketing and Fundraising: From planning our socials (Quiz nights, talent shows, and movie nights), to organizing and running the fundraisers, and creating marketing content for the social media. If you’re interested in any of these, this one is for you! ⭐So, what’s in it for you? 🤩CV benefits, hands on experience you won’t get anywhere else, exclusive workshops, job opportunities, and competitions. 🌍The biggest and probably most exciting events are our Regional, National, and Global Competitions. Where we compete against other universities, presenting our projects and the amount of impact we are making in our community. partake in our regional, national and global competition. 💛Being a part of Enactus Southampton is an experience you will never regret, you’ll meet like-minded people, have some amazing opportunities, and give back to your community! 👀If you think this could be you, feel free to reach out to our Instagram for more information, and check out our events coming up!

societies.name: Krishna Consciousness Society
societies.description: Krishna Consciousness Society is a welcoming student-led society that gives students a calm, uplifting and open space to explore spirituality, mindfulness, philosophy and personal growth. Rooted in the teachings of Krishna consciousness and Vedic wisdom, the society is open to everyone, regardless of faith, background, culture or previous experience. At its heart, KCSOC is about community. University can be an exciting time, but it can also feel stressful, isolating and overwhelming. Our society aims to offer students a space where they can pause, reflect, meet like-minded people and have meaningful conversations beyond the usual pressures of academic life. Through open discussions, meditation, kirtan, guest speakers, retreats, volunteering opportunities, social events and shared meals, we hope to create an environment where students feel supported, valued and inspired. Our sessions explore topics that are genuinely relevant to student life, such as purpose, identity, happiness, stress, relationships, comparison, discipline, self-confidence and finding balance. The aim is to make spirituality feel practical and accessible, rather than distant or difficult to understand. Students are encouraged to ask questions, share their own thoughts and take away ideas that can help them in their studies, relationships and personal lives. KCSOC also gives students the opportunity to experience practices such as meditation and kirtan, which can help promote calmness, gratitude and a more positive mindset. Alongside this, the society encourages service, compassion and friendship, helping students build strong connections with others who are also interested in living with more intention and awareness. As part of the wider UK Krishna Consciousness Society network, members may also have the chance to attend retreats, national events and inter-university gatherings. These opportunities allow students to meet people from other universities, take part in spiritual and cultural activities, and feel part of a wider supportive community. Overall, Krishna Consciousness Society exists to bring students together in a kind, thoughtful and inclusive environment. We want to support student wellbeing, encourage open discussion, and help people explore spirituality in a way that feels meaningful, practical and relevant to modern university life.

societies.name: Once a Month
societies.description: Once a Month is a volunteer project, created to fight against period poverty. Once a Month at the University of Southampton has been successfully running for the academic year of 2020/2021. Ideally, the project would go on for one hour each month and would be a fun, relaxing space in which volunteers can make friends with like-minded people. At these sessions, volunteers will pack bags containing sanitary and hygiene products. Due to the pandemic and government lockdowns, we have not been able to meet regularly; however, we have been able to make large amounts of donations. These bags that we pack are taken to charities and organizations by the project leaders with the assistance of a few volunteers. We have been in contact with a variety of charities in Southampton that have accepted donations from us. Once a Month was originally started at the University of Manchester and this academic year has been the start of the third year that the project has run there. We have based our project on what has worked and what has not worked for them, keeping in constant contact with their project leaders. Given the current pandemic and the shortages that charities are facing, this project will be extremely beneficial to both charities and students, enabling the University of Southampton to support the wider community.

societies.name: Showstoppers
societies.description: Showstoppers is the University of Southampton’s Musical Theatre Society. We welcome anyone with an interest in performing, directing, musical directing, choreographing or producing. Showstoppers is open to all abilities- whether you’ve been performing since you were a kid or just fancy trying something new at university! We do anywhere between 4-6 shows a year, with the first show being our ‘Freshers’ show, which is open to anyone who hasn’t performed with us before. We then have our Small show (which has a smaller cast), Spring show and Summer show. Depending on the year, we will also do an Independent Show (usually an originally written piece) and take a show up to the Edinburgh Fringe. Additionally, we have been competing in IUMTF (the Inter University Musical Theatre Festival) for a few years now. In 2024, we won the competition at Durham and subsequently hosted the festival in Southampton in 2025. We plan to compete again in 2026! Whilst all of our shows are auditioned, we also have many ways to get involved that don’t require auditioning. These include our workshops, which are led by our Development Officers, and focus on strengthening musical theatre skills. We also have termly Cabarets, where anyone can sign up to sing and perform in front of other members of the society. We are very active on social media, so please keep an eye on our accounts for more information about shows, workshops and our Freshers events! If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our Webmaster via our social media, or email president.susushowstoppers@gmail.com.

societies.name: Sinfonietta
societies.description: Southampton University Sinfonietta (Sinf) is a high–quality chamber orchestra, comprising of many of the top student instrumentalists at the University. We are entirely student run, relying on the commitment, dedication and enthusiasm from our members in order to further build upon Sinfonietta’s outstanding reputation. Our aims are to provide members with an incredibly valuable musical and social experience, inclusive of those wishing to engage in a future musical career, and those who study under other faculties at the University. We give members the experience working with a different professional conductor each term and performing a minimum of four concerts a year. Each year we cover a wide range of repertoire and have had collaborations with musicians from across the UK such as from Royal College of Music, Bournemouth Symphony Orchestra, and London Philharmonic Orchestra. Sinfonietta is a friendly group of passionate musicians and, being a chamber orchestra, each orchestral part is much more significant and therefore our members feel really included. Rehearsals are held mostly on Thursday evenings at the university and auditions are held at the start of each new academic year.

societies.name: Singapore Society
societies.description: The University of Southampton Singapore Society (SingSoc) is a place for students, Singaporean and non Singaporean alike, to immerse in uniquely Singaporean culture, and engage in a familiar community through casual and annually organised social and professional events. We are a diverse society comprising of students from varied backgrounds and nationalities that include students from Malaysia, Brunei, Hong Kong, China, and the United Kingdom to name a few. Our primary aim is to provide help and specific knowledge to all members, as well as new or exchange students to the University of Southampton from Singapore. We hope to help ease the transition from the comforts of home to the independent overseas student life with tips, advice and personal experiences. In addition, we aim to provide members and students who are interested in Singapore's culture with more detailed and personal information on our homeland, especially to students who wish to pursue an exchange semester in Singapore. As a society we organise social trips within the UK, dinners commemorating various festive occasions and our annual Summer Chalet BBQ in Singapore. We build bonds with our members through regular sport sessions, and both inter and intra University sporting tournaments. We also constantly update members on any events organised by the SingSocs of other UK Universities. As our society liaises with companies and government departments, we periodically inform our members of career opportunities offered by establishments in Singapore so as to provide them with assistance in career development.

societies.description: The Edge is Southampton's award-winning entertainment magazine, run solely by students at the university. Here at The Edge we cover all aspects of entertainment writing, from reviews and interviews, to critical feature pieces and the latest news within the industry. We’ve covered big releases, such as an early album stream of Olivia Rodrigo’s GUTS, a private screening for Parasite, and an interview with beabadoobee, right through to local university news like the Share the Sound Festival put on by our Music department, and shows put on by our theatre societies such as Be More Chill and The Trial of Dorian Gray. Whether you study humanities or computer science, we want to hear from you. To write for The Edge, the only criteria is that you’re a University of Southampton student with a love for entertainment – whether that be film, theatre, literature, or even podcasts! No experience is required, and we all started a little messy when we began writing for The Edge, so please don’t let fears about your writing ability put you off.Passion is what we’re interested in, and that will shine through no matter your experience!

societies.name: The Mindful Medical Society
societies.description: The Mindful Medical Society opens the exploration of health and human flourishing to all staff and students. We have two main aims: (1) Broaden Perspectives on Health: We explore diverse ideas on health and human flourishing to nuance understandings of what it means to care and be cared for. Events in the 25/26 calendar included: Collaborating in Illness (Dean of Southampton Medical School, Professor Diana Eccles); Are plants more then placebos? (Dr Wilcox); Cold Water Therapy (Associate Professor Heather Massey); Restructuring Mental Healthcare (Dr Armstrong); How we Suffer (Consultant Psychiatrist Carlos Hoyos); The Science of Breathing (Dr Mohan). (2) Enhance Student Welfare: We actively combat declining student wellbeing through yoga, breathwork, and meditation sessions that build compassion for self and others. By promoting a more nuanced account of how to deliver, understand and access optimal health, we hope to improve the wellbeing of all at Southampton University.

societies.name: University of Southampton 180 Degrees Consulting
societies.description: Welcome to 180 Degrees Consulting Southampton! Join a community-driven society where students like you play a pivotal role in transforming local businesses, charities, and non-profits. We're not just about consulting – we're about making a real impact while enhancing your skills and future prospects. At 180 Degrees Consulting, we offer a unique blend of practical experience, affordable services, and tailored training sessions led by industry experts and academic leaders. It's a chance to sharpen your talents and gain invaluable insights from the best in the field. By becoming a part of our society, you'll embark on a journey of personal and professional growth, all while contributing meaningfully to our local community. Together, we'll navigate exciting projects and leave a lasting legacy that extends far beyond our campus. Are you ready to elevate your student experience and make a difference? Join us at 180 Degrees Consulting Southampton – where passion meets purpose.
societies.instagram_bio: @uni_southampton branch of the world’s largest university-based consultancy for non-profits and social enterprises.

societies.name: University of Southampton Ophthalmology Society
societies.description: The University of Southampton Ophthalmology Society is a student-led society dedicated to promoting interest in ophthalmology, eye health and vision science. We aim to provide accessible opportunities for all students to learn about ophthalmology as a medical and surgical specialty through careers talks, clinical skills workshops, academic teaching, research and audit opportunities, mentorship, and networking with clinicians and trainees. We support students considering ophthalmology, improve exposure to a specialty that can be underrepresented in the medical curriculum, and encourage wider engagement with eye health, visual science and healthcare innovation. We are proudly supported by consultants at the UHS Eye Unit, helping us connect students with local clinical expertise, mentorship and insight into the world of ophthalmology!

societies.name: Vegan and Vegetarian Society
societies.description: Whether you're a vegetarian, pescetarian, vegan, or an open-minded omnivore, join the Southampton Vegan and Vegetarian society to have fun and enjoy the benefits. Our society aims to bring together like-minded people, to enjoy a variety of activities including restaurant trips, cooking events, themed food nights, movie nights, speaker events, debates and much more!We also offer support for people who are interested in becoming vegetarian or vegan, as well as those who already are, by sharing cooking skills, recipes and advice.

societies.name: Vietnamese Society
societies.description: Vietnamese Society in Southampton (VietSoc Southampton) is a student-led community that aims to bring together Vietnamese students at the University of Southampton through cultural events, social gatherings, and sports activities. We strive to create a space where Vietnamese identity is celebrated, traditions are preserved, and meaningful connections are formed. While our society primarily serves the Vietnamese student body, we warmly welcome all students who have a connection to, or interest in, Vietnamese culture. With a strong commitment to representing our homeland abroad, we aspire to become the official voice of the Vietnamese student community — sharing the warmth of our culture and bringing a sense of home to those living far from it.

societies.name: Wild Swimming society
societies.description: The Southampton University Wild Swimming society (SUWS) is an inclusive society where we can all share a love for adventure, spending time in beautiful outdoor locations, and immersing ourselves in nature's waters. The society organizes regular trips to our local wild swimming locations and exciting adventures to more picturesque destinations further afield. Besides the profound positive impact on our physical and mental health that comes with wild swimming, SUWS offers a thrilling and sociable way to immerse in nature.

societies.name: Wilderness and Expedition Medicine
societies.description: Southampton Wilderness and Expedition Medicine Society = SWEMS! We run talks, scenario sessions and teaching events themed around Wilderness (jungle, deep sea, desert, polar) medicine, but are most well-known for our group walks and camping trips which in the past year took us to areas of natural beauty such as Brecon, Snowdonia, the South Downs and Dorset. We have a huge mix of experience when it comes to outdoorsy stuff/wilderness medicine, so our camping trips and teaching sessions are very relaxed and cater to all levels and backgrounds. We are a small but welcoming society who love the outdoors for its beauty, the chats and friendships which happen within. If you love walking in the natural world with genuinely genuine people then SWEMS is for you, and we will welcome you with open arms and muddy boots.
societies.instagram_bio: Southampton Wilderness/Expedition Medicine Society, better known as SWEMS! We offer walks, hikes, and strolls. With some medicine. Of course. 🏔 🥾 🩺🚑

societies.name: Wildlife Society
societies.description: 𓍊𓋼𓍊𓋼𓍊 Hi! We're Wildlife Society! 𓍊𓋼𓍊𓋼𓍊 We run nature-themed events and trips in the Southampton area and all over the UK! Everyone is welcome, regardless of their degree or previous experience, all you need is a passion for wildlife. Our regular events include weekly documentary screenings, mushroom walks, pub and sober socials, as well as big trips to museums, aquariums, and wildlife parks. We primarily use Instagram to advertise, as well as a WhatsApp chat we use that's linked on our Instagram! Join a relaxed, inclusive community of nature nerds! Make friends, take part in competitions and explore the world around you!
